approvedTextRoleMappings.label: B
approvedTextRoleMappings.role: Screw rod associated with changes in the sealed container's volume.
approvedTextRoleMappings.basis: Both complete approved N12 texts explicitly name screw rod B. This resolves the intended modern label without claiming the original glyph's alphabet.

approvedTextRoleMappings.label: L
approvedTextRoleMappings.role: Ruler whose position reading is associated with volume change in the book's apparatus model.
approvedTextRoleMappings.basis: Both complete approved N12 texts explicitly name ruler L. A pixel-only glyph ambiguity need not block this text-authorized role mapping.

approvedTextRoleMappings.label: M
approvedTextRoleMappings.role: Pressure instrument connected to the sealed corrugated container.
approvedTextRoleMappings.basis: Both complete approved N12 texts explicitly name pressure gauge M.

recoverableQualitativeStructure: One source apparatus view with left corrugated container, vertical screw and supporting frame.
One right circular pointer instrument with a lower stem and branched base.
A prominent pointer directed toward the upper-right face, without assigning an angle or reading.
Visible hose routes between the left upper fitting region and the right stem's left fitting region.
Text-authorized modern labels B, L, and M.

decisiveRequiredPixelAmbiguities.unavailable: A unique complete set and count of visible dial ticks and glyphs. Some short strokes merge with small numeral-like glyphs and inner borders.
decisiveRequiredPixelAmbiguities.whyNotJustNumericMeaning: Even if all numerical values remain unknown, a source-faithful qualitative scale needs the actual visible mark identities, counts, and placement. Those cannot all be recovered uniquely.

decisiveRequiredPixelAmbiguities.unavailable: A unique complete ruler tick set and count at frame, rim, and base overlaps.
decisiveRequiredPixelAmbiguities.whyNotJustNumericMeaning: Unknown unit and volume calibration do not authorize adding, deleting, regularizing, or guessing the source's visible ruler marks.
forbiddenSubstitutions: Omission of the source ruler scale

additionalPixelLimitations.limitation: Dark merged and occluded transitions do not expose exact port boundaries and every hose join.
additionalPixelLimitations.interpretation: The approved prose supports container-to-pressure-instrument connectivity, not an invented hidden passage or a chosen detailed joint.

additionalPixelLimitations.limitation: Some thread, rib, layered-base, and projection boundaries merge with outlines or shading.
additionalPixelLimitations.interpretation: The source inventory preserves this uncertainty instead of asserting exact component counts.

route.reason: Remaining required source marks are ambiguous. Stop before native draft validation/rendering; do not create a speculative candidate or a generic replacement.
